disposable_data_identifiers_sanitized.access_code: generated through owner settings UI; not recorded

qa_setup.step: Created disposable fixed-salary worker through authenticated owner UI.
Adjusted disposable worker start_date through Supabase REST table API, not SQL.
qa_setup.outcome: start_date changed from 2026-07-02 to 2026-06-01 for pay-cycle visibility.

qa_setup.step: Temporarily widened disposable tenant payroll reminder window through Supabase REST table API, not SQL.
qa_setup.outcome: pay_reminder_days changed from 3 to 14, then restored to 3 after proof.

qa_setup.step: Created throwaway QA owner identities through Supabase Auth Admin for authenticated API-role RPC probes.
qa_setup.outcome: JWT claims contained org_id suffix 545d91c7 and owner role.

runtime_browser_steps: Opened http://localhost:3000/owner/payroll in the in-app browser.
Confirmed authenticated QA owner session in disposable B21B factory.
Opened owner Workers page and created BATCH21D fixed worker.
Opened payroll final-settlement dialog for the BATCH21D fixed worker.
Observed Confirm disabled with no payment method and no owner verification.
Selected Cash payment mode and observed Confirm still disabled while owner verification remained unchecked.
Checked owner verification and observed Confirm enabled.
Clicked Confirm and observed the BATCH21D row become Paid, Final, Cash with Mark Unpaid available.
Opened Secure Reversal dialog and observed Confirm Reversal disabled with empty access code.
Entered invalid six-character code and clicked Confirm Reversal.
Observed Invalid or expired access code toast and the row remained Paid with Mark Unpaid.
Generated a one-time access code through owner Settings UI without recording the code.
Reopened Secure Reversal dialog, entered valid code, and clicked Confirm Reversal.
Observed the BATCH21D row return to Pending with Mark Paid disabled by the current-cycle pay-window state.
api_runtime_steps: Called settle_worker_payroll_hardened as authenticated QA owner with null payment mode.
Called settle_worker_payroll_hardened as authenticated QA owner with payment mode cash and verified_by_owner false.
Called legacy settle_worker_payroll directly as authenticated QA owner.
Called legacy unsettle_worker_payroll directly as authenticated QA owner.
Called unsettle_worker_payroll_hardened with the already-consumed valid access code as authenticated QA owner.

payment_mode_without_owner_verification_.evidence: After Cash selection, Confirm remained disabled until owner verification was checked.

missing_payment_mode_hardened_rpc.error_message: payment_mode is required for payroll settlement

missing_owner_verification_hardened_rpc.error_message: owner verification is required for payroll settlement

without_access_code_ui.evidence: Confirm Reversal disabled when OTP textbox was empty.

invalid_access_code_ui.evidence: Invalid or expired access code toast; settlement remained Paid with Mark Unpaid.

valid_access_code_ui_action.evidence: BATCH21D row returned to Pending and Mark Paid became the available action.

PAY-018.reason: Runtime UI/action and authenticated API-role proof show payment mode and owner verification are required; valid settlement succeeds only after both are present; legacy direct settlement RPC is not callable by authenticated API role.

PAY-020.reason: Runtime UI/action proof shows empty and invalid access codes are blocked, valid one-time code reverses the settlement, post-reversal state is pending/no July settlement row, consumed code cannot be reused, and legacy direct reversal RPC is not callable by authenticated API role.
